description: This file contains functions related to HTML parsing, specifically handling foreign attributes, integration points, and tag adjustments within an HTML parser implementation.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents an HTML node with properties like Type, Namespace, Data, and Attr.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: Represents an HTML attribute with properties Key and Val.

methods.name: adjustAttributeNames
methods.description: Adjusts attribute names based on a provided name mapping.

methods.name: adjustForeignAttributes
methods.description: Adjusts foreign attributes, setting namespace and key based on specific attribute keys.

methods.name: htmlIntegrationPoint
methods.description: Determines if a node is an HTML integration point based on its namespace and data.

methods.name: mathMLTextIntegrationPoint
methods.description: Checks if a node is a MathML text integration point based on its namespace and data.
